name: Firebase Cloud Messaging

dataTypes.type: Device or other IDs / Device or other IDs
dataTypes.when: Always: Firebase installation ID (FID), a per-installation identifier, collected by the transitively included Firebase installations SDK (com.google.firebase:firebase-installations). FCM uses it to issue the registration token used to deliver messages.

ask: Do you send the FCM registration token to your own backend and link it to a user account? If yes, also consider Personal info / User IDs for the linkage your backend does.
Do you include Google Analytics for Firebase? FCM then logs notification interaction events through Analytics; make sure the firebase-analytics entry is declared.
Have you enabled BigQuery export of delivery metrics (setDeliveryMetricsExportToBigQuery(true))? Message delivery metrics are then exported.
Do your push payloads carry personal data (messages, names)? Declare those data types for your own server-side handling.

sources.title: Prepare for Google Play's data disclosure requirements (Firebase)

notes: Firebase lists for FCM: application version (for topic subscribe/unsubscribe) and the Firebase user agent (device metadata, installer, SDK versions; 'never linked to a user or device identifier'). Neither maps cleanly to a Play data type, so they are not listed. The identifier comes from the firebase-installations dependency. firebase-messaging-directboot is on Google Maven but not named on the Firebase page; included in match because it is an FCM add-on. Firebase's page does not give a per-product collected/shared table; it states globally that Firebase does not transfer the listed data to third parties except to subprocessors that help provide Firebase services or per the developer's instructions (e.g. linking to non-Firebase services). On that basis shared=false and role=service-provider. The page lists raw data items (e.g. 'stack traces', 'IP address'), not Play data-type labels; the mapping to Play labels and purposes here is ours.
